description: Audit an entire legal brief, petition, or opponent argument for citation accuracy and Article 141 binding precedent validity. Automatically extracts every citation (INSC, SCC, AIR, SCR, MANU, or case name), verifies current treatment status (flagging OVERRULED or superseded authorities), checks the Article 141 bench-strength hierarchy, and returns tactical counter-arguments.

focus_issue.description: Optional legal topic to prioritize in the tactical analysis.

text.description: The brief, petition excerpt, opponent arguments, or paragraph containing legal citations to audit.

name: audit_brief
